name: modernuo
description: Official-UO research and ModernUO engineering workflows

interface.shortDescription: Official UO evidence, ModernUO engineering, and strict issue delivery.
interface.longDescription: A repository-portable Agent Skills portfolio for official OSI/EA/Broadsword research, ModernUO engineering, RunUO migration, testing, and a strict create-research-implement GitHub workflow. Issue skills resolve the exact repository from the consuming project's AGENTS.md and stop whenever official evidence or user policy is incomplete.
defaultPrompt: Create an intake issue using the repository and live template declared by this project's AGENTS.md.
Research this issue against official OSI/EA sources and stop to ask me about unresolved decisions.
Implement this issue from its current READY research handoff and run focused verification.
Establish the official UO behavior for this mechanic and compare it with the configured repository.
Audit this ModernUO subsystem for persistence, lifecycle, performance, and regression risks.
Migrate this RunUO code to current ModernUO conventions.
Design focused ModernUO behavior tests and report their exact scope.
